title: Article
description: A news article returned by the NewsAPI

source.description: The news source or blog that the article originated from

id.description: The identifier of the news source. Can be used with other endpoints.

name.description: The display name of the news source.

title.description: The headline or title of the article.

description.description: A description or snippet from the article.
description.example: Apple Inc. reported record quarterly earnings today, beating analyst expectations.

url.description: The direct URL to the article.

urlToImage.description: The URL to a relevant image for the article.

publishedAt.description: The date and time that the article was published, in UTC.

content.description: The unformatted content of the article, truncated to 200 characters.
content.example: Apple Inc. reported record quarterly earnings today... [+4500 chars]
